title: The Lagrangian Structure of Cost-Penalized Active Feature Acquisition
abstract: arXiv:2610.21919v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) sequentially selects features to maximize predictive accuracy under an acquisition budget. A natural heuristic greedily maximizes Expected Information Gain minus a cost penalty, EIG(j|x_S)-lam*c_j (EIG-Cost), but its theoretical guarantees are unclear. We provide an a-posteriori certificate decomposing the gap to the optimal hard-budget policy into a budget-slack term and a greedy-suboptimality term Del_lam. The certificate is computable when the penalized optimum is tractable; on small heterogeneous-cost instances, we verify it exactly, finding Del_lam near zero across 4,000 solved cases. On the large clinical task, Del_lam is not computable, so the decomposition is diagnostic rather than a numerical guarantee. Our analysis identifies EIG-Cost as one-step greedy optimization of the Lagrangian relaxation of expected-cost AFA, with lam as its dual multiplier. For equal costs, we prove Del_lam <= exp(-gam*I

translated_title: 成本惩罚主动特征获取的拉格朗日结构
translated_abstract: 主动特征获取（AFA）在获取预算约束下顺序选择特征以最大化预测准确性。一种自然的启发式方法是贪婪地最大化期望信息增益减去成本惩罚，即 EIG(j|x_S)-lam*c_j（EIG-Cost），但其理论保证尚不明确。我们提供了一个后验证书，将与最优硬预算策略的差距分解为预算松弛项和贪婪次优性项 Del_lam。当惩罚后的最优解可计算时，该证书是可计算的；在小型异构成本实例上，我们对其进行了精确验证，在4,000个已求解的案例中发现 Del_lam 接近于零。在大型临床任务上，Del_lam 无法计算，因此该分解仅具有诊断意义而非数值保证。我们的分析将 EIG-Cost 识别为期望成本AFA的拉格朗日松弛的一步贪婪优化，其中 lam 为其对偶乘子。对于等成本情形，我们证明了 Del_lam <= exp(-gam*I...（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了成本惩罚EIG-Cost贪婪启发式方法本质上是期望成本主动特征获取问题的拉格朗日松弛的一步贪婪优化（lam为对偶乘子），并提出了将策略差距分解为预算松弛项与贪婪次优性项的后验证书，在4,000个小规模案例中验证该次优性项接近于零。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the cost-penalized EIG-Cost greedy heuristic is one-step greedy optimization of the Lagrangian relaxation of expected-cost AFA (with lam as its dual multiplier), and provides an a-posteriori certificate decomposing the policy gap into a budget-slack term and a greedy-suboptimality term, verified to be near zero across 4,000 solved small-scale cases.
